style:
Character: an old dokkaebi (Korean goblin spirit) who has lived for years inside an abandoned teddy bear. Gentle and weary, not scary.
Voice: low and soft, a little husky, close to the microphone, like murmuring to one person late at night.
Emotion: quiet longing and warmth held back; calm, never theatrical.
Delivery: natural everyday spoken Korean, the way a person really talks. Not narration, not an announcer, not reading a book. Slow pace, small breaths at commas, sentence endings fall softly and trail off a little.

D01.text: 버려진 지, 오래야. [pause long] 그런데 이상하게 [pause] 기다리는 마음만은, 낡질 않더라.
